incident_updates.body:
Miro Infrastructure Engineering will perform essential maintenance on our CDN services across all regions on **Saturday, October 3rd, starting at 08:00 AM CET**. The maintenance is expected to take up to **2 hours**.

During this window, Miro may appear offline or experience degraded performance. No action is needed on your part — normal service will resume automatically once maintenance is complete.

We appreciate your patience and apologize for any inconvenience.
